title: Children's Bedtime Stories (Ages 3–4)
summary: Original, gentle, audio-first bedtime stories for children ages 3 to 4, primarily age three. Forty-five standalone stories use one narrator, with playful journeys, small discoveries, gentle surprises, everyday kindness, and quiet endings. Not every story teaches a lesson. Parent notes with source links and clear evidence limits are not spoken. No character voice acting, music, or sound effects are required.
assumed_background: Designed for listeners ages 3–4; no prior familiarity with the characters or other episodes required.

lectures.title: Danny and the Missing Blanket
lectures.description: A bedtime search for a favorite blue blanket, ending with a remembered afternoon game.

lectures.title: The Little Cloud That Couldn't Settle
lectures.description: A drifting cloud discovers how to rest without stopping the wind.

lectures.title: Lisa and the Moonlight Garden
lectures.description: A child and her grandmother identify three small nighttime sounds before returning to bed.

lectures.title: Danny and the Two Shovels
lectures.description: Danny keeps using his shovel; Sam finds another way to play, and the friends build a small world side by side.

lectures.title: The Footprints by the Pond
lectures.description: Sam and Danny make guesses about marks beside a pond, then watch a small duck drag a twig through the mud.

lectures.title: Sam's Tower Falls Down
lectures.description: A fallen block tower disappoints Sam; after a break and help with one step, he builds a different little house.

lectures.title: The Hedgehog Who Didn't Say Hello
lectures.description: Danny takes a missed greeting personally but learns that Kate was occupied in the wind.

lectures.title: The Little Bird Who Needed Help
lectures.description: Beth tries to hang a leaf curtain, asks Mama Bird to steady one side, and completes the job.

lectures.title: The Very Important Puddle
lectures.description: Sam plays in a puddle, Kate notices the sky reflected in it, and Danny finds a dry way around.

lectures.title: Sam's Very Small Parade
lectures.description: Sam marches with a red leaf; friends join him, and the parade accidentally gives a snail a splendid hat.

lectures.title: Lisa and the Backward Pajamas
lectures.description: A backward pajama top leads to slipper mittens, a very serious teddy bear, and a pretend moon in a pocket.

lectures.title: Pete and the Leaf Letter
lectures.description: A garden snail carries a little picture-letter past a pebble hill and grass forest to invite Kate to watch the evening sky.

lectures.title: Sam's Pillow Orchestra
lectures.description: Friends find a soft thump, a puff, a rustle, and a tap, then notice the quieter sounds around them.

lectures.title: Kate's Hat Shop
lectures.description: Kate tries hats on a watering can, a pumpkin, a fence post, and eventually a very fashionable mouse.

lectures.title: Lisa's Carpet Sea
lectures.description: A blanket becomes a sea, a towel becomes a mountain, and a stuffed bear finds a quiet bay for a nap.

lectures.title: Lisa's Cardboard Moon Mission
lectures.description: A cardboard-box rocket makes a very quiet pretend trip to the moon and brings a present made from a blue sock.

lectures.title: Sam and the Very Long Goodnight
lectures.description: Sam tries to say goodnight to every object, pebble, and leaf, then remembers one sleepy mouse.

lectures.title: Danny and the Wobbly Pancake
lectures.description: Danny and Aunt Sue make pancakes shaped like an elephant, a boot, a moon, and a turtle.

lectures.title: Kate's Museum of Ordinary Things
lectures.description: Kate opens a tiny museum containing a stone, a leaf window, a pine cone, and a surprise gift shop.

lectures.title: Pete and the Leaf Umbrella
lectures.description: Pete enjoys the rain, Sam dislikes wet socks, and a broad leaf makes the walk home easier.

lectures.title: Beth's Nest of Soft Things
lectures.description: Beth searches for a comfy resting spot, testing grass and a crinkly leaf with help from Mama Bird.

lectures.title: Abby and the Underwater Garden
lectures.description: Abby the octopus builds a sand garden with pebbles, ribbons of seaweed, and bubbles that keep rising.

lectures.title: Puff and the Too-Many Pockets
lectures.description: A cloud with seven pockets collects a paper crown, a cookie, a feather, and even a yawn.

lectures.title: Mike and the Star in the Pond
lectures.description: Mike the otter notices a star reflected in the pond and follows changes when a leaf and breeze pass.

lectures.title: The Tallest Hat in Mushroom Village
lectures.description: A beetle builds a hat too tall for any doorway; it becomes a strange little roof for village visitors.

lectures.title: The Night Train to Pillow Mountain
lectures.description: A child imagines a wooden train traveling over Button Bridge through Blanket Meadow to a pillow-shaped mountain.

lectures.title: The Cave That Giggled Back
lectures.description: Fran the little goat and Grandpa discover a soft echo outside a shallow cave, then settle into listening.

lectures.title: Mona and the Daisy Sneeze
lectures.description: A friendly dragon sneezes daisies into a picnic; her friends find the flowers very funny.

lectures.title: The Little Red Wagon's Holiday
lectures.description: Lisa takes her everyday garden wagon on a small holiday with Grandpa, all the way to the bean patch.

lectures.title: The Upside-Down Picnic Map
lectures.description: Danny and Kate follow a picture map, notice the pond on the wrong side, and turn the paper around.

lectures.title: Tina and the Lantern Shadow
lectures.description: A little moth makes an enormous playful shadow beside a softly lit porch and discovers whose shape it is.

lectures.title: The Giant's Small Quilt
lectures.description: A mouse offers a little patchwork quilt to a giant, who finds it makes an excellent blanket for one chilly toe.

lectures.title: The Stars' Small Camping Trip
lectures.description: Three make-believe stars camp between clouds with a tiny spoon, pretend moonberry soup, and an unhurried goodnight.

lectures.title: June and the Bakery That Went for a Walk
lectures.description: A turtle carries a tiny bakery on her shell, so the shop visits its customers and finds a quiet place under an apple tree.

lectures.title: Lisa and the Invisible Dinosaur
lectures.description: Lisa and Grandpa search for an invisible pretend dinosaur whose footprints are slippers and whose tail is a scarf.

lectures.title: Eddie's Upside-Down Bed
lectures.description: Pete the snail discovers why Eddie the bat is comfortable resting upside down while Pete prefers his leaf and shell.

lectures.title: The Clock That Wanted a Nap
lectures.description: A round kitchen clock imagines cozy places to nap while the house gets quieter and Lisa wishes it goodnight.

lectures.title: Kate's Painting for the Wind
lectures.description: Kate draws swirls and helps hang colored ribbons that move with the wind, creating a picture that changes.

lectures.title: Dora and the Sea's Smallest Song
lectures.description: A young seal listens to waves, water between stones, and the softer sounds of a sheltered cove beside her mother.

lectures.title: Joe and the Very Helpful Tail
lectures.description: A puppy tries to keep his wagging tail out of the way while Dad tidies the sitting room, only to discover what it has found.

lectures.title: Kate and the Raindrop Roads
lectures.description: Kate watches two drops travel down the outside of a window, join other drops, and make changing little roads in the rain.

lectures.title: Danny and the Carrot with Two Legs
lectures.description: Danny finds a forked carrot at harvest time and gives it pretend boots before drawing its wonderfully crooked shape.

lectures.title: The Beetle Bus and the Crooked Road
lectures.description: A seedpod-sized garden bus meets a fallen leaf across its road and takes a new route to deliver its passengers home.

lectures.title: Lisa and the Elevator That Went Down First
lectures.description: Lisa and Grandpa ride a library elevator the wrong direction at first, discover the book carts below, and finally reach the upstairs picture books.

lectures.title: Dora and the Lighthouse's Little Blink
lectures.description: Dora the young seal watches a lighthouse go dark between flashes and learns to wait comfortably for its next small blink.
